cohort: 150 nulliparous women aged 18-35 years with singleton pregnancies, cephalic presentation, gestational ages 37-42 weeks, unfavorable Bishop's score (<=5), and reactive fetal heart rates, with no contraindications to vaginal delivery.
finding: The incidence of C-section delivery was 28%.
mod_finding: The most common indication for C-section was secondary arrest of labor.
